name: @deepseaxx/koishi-plugin-image-selector
description: Organize images and videos into keyword folders, then send or save them easily in Koishi

description.en: Organize images and videos by keyword folders, send random files, and save media from messages with aliases and upload limits.
description.zh: 按关键词文件夹整理图片和视频，支持随机发图、回复存图、别名匹配和上传权限限制。
